question: Where can I get a list of large industrial facilities in the United States, with location, sector, operator and annual emissions by pollutant, including CO2?

answer.summary: Three EPA programs answer different parts. The GHGRP (Envirofacts API) gives facility coordinates, NAICS, parent company and annual CO2, CH4 and N2O by sector for 11,281 facility records in reporting year 2023, the latest published year. TRI (API, RY2024) gives toxic-chemical releases by facility in pounds. NEI 2023 (downloadable) gives point-source criteria and hazardous air pollutants by process but no CO2. Facility ids differ across programs, so joins rely on FRS ids, TRI ids carried in NEI, or name and coordinates.
main_caveats: GHGRP covers facilities above a threshold (generally 25,000 t CO2e/year, 40 CFR 98.2); its latest published year is 2023. EPA has not published 2024; only EIP's FOIA copy is known.
API gas rows hold CO2e; for CO2 it equals tonnes, but CH4 and N2O rows are CO2e (518.22 t CH4 appears as 12,955.5); V_GHG_EMITTER_SUBPART gives ghg_quantity (mass).
A facility has several rows per gas (one per sector/subpart): Baytown refinery 12,561,038 + 60,478 t CO2 must be summed; supplier quantities are not emissions.
NEI units differ by pollutant (criteria pollutants in tons, hazardous air pollutants in pounds), it is triennial (2023) and has no CO2; TRI is in pounds (dioxins in grams).
Operator is not published as such: GHGRP/TRI give parent company with ownership percent; TRI longitude is stored unsigned (95.0069 for -95.0069).
Region 6 NEI only was read (partial download); TRI and NEI reporting thresholds were not verified.
answer.confidence_reason: GHGRP, TRI and NEI were queried or downloaded and one Baytown, TX site was traced across the three; thresholds for TRI and NEI are unverified.

attributes.note: Lat/long per facility in GHGRP (6 decimals), NEI site coordinates and TRI preferred coordinates (longitude unsigned).
GHGRP naics_code, subpart and sector; NEI primary NAICS code, description and facility source type. TRI sector not verified in the API.
GHGRP parent_company with % ownership; NEI company name; TRI parent_co_name. Operator is not distinguished from owner.
attributes.gap_note: Parent company or owner is published, not the operating entity; the source does not flag corporate headquarters vs site operator.

attributes.note: GHGRP t CO2 (RY2023, latest), NEI tons/pounds by pollutant (2023) and TRI pounds by chemical (RY2024); CO2 vs CO2e separable.

sources.name: EPA GHGRP in Envirofacts (V_GHG_EMITTER_GAS, PUB_DIM_FACILITY)
sources.adds: Facility-level greenhouse-gas emissions by gas and sector, with coordinates, NAICS, FRS id and parent company, 2010 to 2023.
sources.summary: Official facility-level CO2, CH4 and N2O with coordinates, NAICS and parent company via a free REST API; latest year 2023.
sources.coverage_note: 11,281 facility records in 2023; reporting threshold generally 25,000 t CO2e/year.

coverage.geographic: United States facilities and suppliers subject to 40 CFR Part 98; 11,281 facility records for 2023.

unit.value: Metric tons CO2e per gas (co2e_emission); mass in ghg_quantity in V_GHG_EMITTER_SUBPART.

inclusion_rule.value: Facilities in covered source categories emitting 25,000 t CO2e or more per year (40 CFR 98.2), plus categories without threshold; biogenic CO2 excluded from the totals shown.

exclusions.value: Facilities below thresholds; suppliers' quantities not emissions.

how_to_use.example_result: EXXONMOBIL Bt Site, Baytown TX (NAICS 324110, FRS 110000463178): CO2 12,561,038.2 t and 60,477.8 t (two sector rows; 12,621,516.0 t in total), CH4 34,444.75 and 5,414.75, N2O 31,990.896 and 180.29 (t CO2e).
steps: Query PUB_DIM_FACILITY/year/=/2023 for attributes and V_GHG_EMITTER_GAS for gases.
Sum rows per facility and gas.
Use V_GHG_EMITTER_SUBPART for subpart breakdown and mass quantities.
reading_traps: One facility has several rows per gas.
co2e_emission is CO2e even for CH4/N2O.
V_GHG_EMITTER_GAS excludes supplier rows (sector 10, Petroleum Product Suppliers, shows 82.2 million t CO2e for this site in PUB_FACTS_SECTOR_GHG_EMISSION).

coverage.geographic: United States and territories; 77,295 forms for RY2024, 78,647 for RY2023.

unit.value: Pounds; dioxin and dioxin-like compounds in grams (EPA data-files page).

how_to_use.example_result: ExxonMobil Baytown Chemical Plant (parent Exxon Mobil Corp), 41 forms for 2024; ammonia stack 2,300 and fugitive 230, toluene fugitive 17,000 (pounds, units read from the EPA data-files page).
steps: Find facility in TRI_FACILITY by name/state.
Join TRI_REPORTING_FORM by facility and year, then TRI_RELEASE_QTY by doc_ctrl_num.
reading_traps: pref_longitude is positive for western US sites (95.0069 for Baytown).
Rows hold zero or null for media not reported.
CO2 is not a TRI chemical.

sources.name: 2023 National Emissions Inventory (NEI) facility-process files
sources.format: Nested ZIP of CSV by EPA region (about 189 MB)
sources.adds: Point-source emissions of criteria and hazardous air pollutants by facility and process with NAICS, company name and TRI id; no CO2.
sources.summary: Official 2023 inventory of criteria and hazardous air pollutants by facility and process; no CO2; units differ by pollutant.

coverage.geographic: United States; Region 6 (TX, LA, OK, AR, NM) file read: 11,949 facilities, 1,606,099 process rows.

unit.value: Tons for criteria pollutants, pounds for hazardous air pollutants (emissions uom column).

inclusion_rule.value: Point sources reported by states and EPA under the AERR; threshold not verified here.

exclusions.value: Mobile, nonpoint and fire sources are in separate files.

how_to_use.example_request: Download 2023nei_facility_process_byregion_21jul2026.zip, unzip the nested Region 6 CSV (emis_sum_proc_38216.csv) and sum 'total emissions' by pollutant for eis facility id 4924411.
how_to_use.example_result: BAYTOWN REFINERY, Exxon Mobil Corp (NAICS 324110, TRI id 77522XXNBY2800D): NOX 1,981 tons, SO2 2,269, CO 1,438, VOC 1,920, toluene 248,388 lb across 6,429 process rows.
